title: Sora Ads After the Shutdown: DIY AI Video or an AI Ad Agency
summary: OpenAI discontinued Sora, so Sora ads are no longer a plan. Compare making AI video ads yourself with hiring an AI ad agency, with prices and Meta label rules.
body_markdown:
You cannot plan new ads around Sora: OpenAI told[CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sora-ai-openai-discontinues/) on March 24, 2026 that it had decided to discontinue Sora in its consumer app and API, and its[deprecations page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations) lists the Videos API and the Sora 2 models for removal on September 24, 2026. The real choice now is between making AI video ads yourself in another tool and hiring an AI ad agency. Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with about 25 a week and optional Meta management. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What happened to Sora, and what does that mean for ads?


OpenAI's deprecations page, checked October 27, 2026, lists the Videos API,` sora-2` ,` sora-2-pro` and their dated snapshots for removal from the API on September 24, 2026, with no replacement listed. That date has passed. If a third-party platform still advertises Sora access, check that platform's current terms, because this guide could not confirm any.


Sora had been used in finished brand work before the shutdown. The[Toys"R"Us studios page](https://www.toysrus.com/pages/studios) lists a brand film made with OpenAI's Sora, with the partner Native Foreign. That shows the tool could help make a finished film. It does not show what a self-serve ad cost or whether it converted, and this guide does not state Sora's former pricing, clip length or usage terms because we could not confirm them from OpenAI's own pages.


## What does an AI video model replace, and what does it not?


A video model generates footage.[Runway's guide to AI-generated commercials](https://runway.com/resources/ai-generated-commercials) describes an AI commercial as an ad in which AI models, working from a prompt, an image or a brief, produce the footage, voice or edit that a camera crew would otherwise make. Runway sells AI video tools, so read that as a vendor's definition. It covers the shoot. It does not cover the customer problem, the product claims, the script, the cut for each placement, Meta's review or the test that decides which ad keeps running.


That gap is why the choice is rarely about the model. Any tool that replaces Sora leaves the same jobs with you, or with a provider you hire.


## Who makes AI ads for you?


### Knowlify: our top pick for finished AI ads, not a tool


With Sora gone, what you need is finished ads, not a model to learn. Knowlify delivers about 25 finished ads a week, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. The three formats are AI UGC with AI presenters, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials, which are live-action-style AI video and the closest to the footage a model like Sora produced. You can add end-to-end Meta campaign management, or buy creative only if you already have a media buyer. The guarantee lets you cancel by email for a full refund if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ), and pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. We have made ads for two named clients, Parva and Casco, and examples are in our[Facebook and Instagram video ad examples](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) . This guide does not state which video models Knowlify uses, so if a specific model matters to you, ask any provider, us included, which models make your ads. Pick another option if you need real human creators on camera or ads on TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube.


### Admiral Media: fixed batches of AI presenter ads


[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) sells batches rather than monthly plans: €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds, €16,000 for 40 up to 30 seconds and €29,000 for 80 up to 60 seconds. Its AI presenters are finished with human editing and quality review. Its page says ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media, and that campaign and budget management must be agreed separately.


### Creatify Studio: managed production with a published comparison price


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is the managed side of Creatify, with a creative team handling strategy, scripting and production, and a person reviewing every ad. Its own comparison table puts the cost at $100 to $200 per video. Its pricing page gives no Studio price and asks for a demo.


### EzUGC: AI or creators on one monthly budget


[EzUGC](https://www.ezugc.ai/ugc-agency) lists $4,000 a month for 50 finished UGC videos, which can be all AI, all real creators or any split. Strategy, hooks, scripts and editing are included, and you approve scripts before anything is filmed or generated. It does not state contract length, turnaround or whether it runs campaigns.


### Unreal UGC: AI creators with a self-serve floor


[Unreal UGC](https://unrealugc.com/pricing) lists self-serve plans from $69 a month. Its done-for-you ads use AI creators and no actors, but it sends those requests to support and does not publish a price for them.


## Which self-serve tools are the do-it-yourself route now?


Self-serve tools cost less to start, and you keep every step. Published prices from October 2026 show the range.[Creatify](https://creatify.ai/pricing) lists its Standard plan at $15 a month billed monthly, or $12 billed annually, with 55 credits.[TopView](https://www.topview.ai/pricing) lists Plus at $36 a month billed annually, with 100 credits a month and no free plan.[MakeUGC](https://makeugc.ai/pricing) lists Starter at $59 a month billed monthly or $29 billed yearly, with 500 credits.[Pencil](https://trypencil.com/pricing) lists a self-serve plan at $14 a month billed monthly for 50 generations, with ad launching among its features.


[Arcads](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17595066-how-does-arcads-pricing-work) does not publish dollar prices on its public pages and sells monthly credit allowances instead. Do not turn credits into a cost per video until you know which plan and generation method it assumes. Our[best AI video ad generators](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ai-video-ad-generators) guide compares these tools more fully.
